Ue.bar_b_note: The warm firelit hall gives real mood, but the rings of identical smoke puffs, the text-led tells and (on B) a ghosted or missing player creature sink it below Palworld's chunky readable combat.

Mo.bar_b_note: A murky, nearly monochrome dark-green frame with no visible purple storm sky, flat magenta floor shapes and (on A) canopy filling whole frames sinks it; the gold spider silhouette is the only thing that carries.

Gk.bar_b_note: Blurry smeared ground textures, a flat untextured tunnel wall, flat midday light and empty plains read as prototype next to Palworld's dense lit fields, though A's after frames at least tell a story.

Ik.bar_b_note: The standing wolf meets the owner's Tanglevolt bar, but A's faint frames break into black-and-white blotches and float off the floor, and B's faint end tips the wolf up onto its nose, so it falls short of a shipping finish.

Ij.bar_b_note: The lush grass and solid creatures come close to Palworld's meadow fights, but a blown-out white sky, a uniform tree line and puff-ring and gold-disc effects keep it short of the same finish.

Rn.bar_b_note: The colourful creatures and dusk castle silhouettes help, but the flat dark paving, crate clutter, smoke rings and (on B) flat white speed slashes plus a camera buried in the bird sink it.

Pe.bar_b_note: The purple storm sky, rain, glass shards and a striking gold spider come close to the brief, but the dark mossy carpet and a player Sparkit too small to find keep it short of Palworld-class readability.

Pf.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder with readable eyes and a Meadows green/brown palette would sit comfortably beside Palworld's humans, though a slightly more cartoon face than the naturalistic creatures is the only friction.

Ge.bar_b_note: Pale dunes and a well-built Cannonback carry some of it, but no Tidewake water, a flat black cliff mass, and a player Ripplet that is ghosted (A) or reduced to a shadow (B) sink it.

top_changes.change: Make the player's creature always solid and findable: fix the translucent or invisible Ripplet (Ge A/B, Ue B), keep both fighters in frame, never put the camera inside a creature or the canopy (Rn B 27750, Mo A i11-i16), and add a rim light so small partners (Sparkit, Terrapup, Brooktail) separate from the ground.

Replace the text-led tells, puff-rings, gold discs, white flash pillars and flat magenta or cyan floor shapes with body-led wind-ups and grounded element impacts at the struck creature's feet (cracked earth, stones, sparks, water splash), and show the stagger in the body.

Bring the world up to finish: sharper ground materials and grouped vegetation on the Meadows sites (Gk, Ij), a graded sky instead of blown-out white, Tidewake water and textured cliffs (Ge), a purple sky and lifted values in Stormwood (Mo), and a fix for the Tanglevolt faint material swap and faint-end pose (Ik).
